claims.text: The experiments used parallel corpora obtained from the multilingual Indian Language Corpora Initiative (ILCI) and the OpenSubtitles2016 section of the OPUS corpus collection.
The experiments involved 16 language pairs, 17 languages, and 10 writing systems, indicating a diverse set of datasets.
The training set sizes varied, and different representation units were tested across these datasets.
